acce.source: ACCE Document 103, Standards and Criteria for Accreditation of Postsecondary Construction Education Degree Programs, revision 2026.10.19 (01_raw_data/acce/document_103_standards_2026-10-19.pdf), Section Three, Table 3.3.1
acce.note: Document 103 sets no total; it requires at least 12 semester hours of business and management (accounting, economics, business law, principles of management) and at least 50 semester hours of construction courses that together address the 17 student learning outcomes (3.4). Section 3.7: a modified degree path that does not meet the curriculum requirements must be identified in marketing as outside the accreditation. The 2026 Midyear (28 February) and Annual (24 July) notices of accreditation actions list no reduced-credit program.
